proposedIsolatedEnvironment.stateProtection: New 0700 state/private directories, 0600 regular non-symlink private credentials and exact journals; use exclusive create/fsync/atomic rename. Never reuse, print or overwrite old GH/private/deployment files.
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.pgNetwork: Rootless slirp4netns, no-new-privileges, loopback-only 127.0.0.1:16432->15432/tcp; independent named volume; never mount existing R0E/GH data or Windows PG17 data
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.pgPortCaveat: Frozen pg-entrypoint.sh hardcodes postgres -p15432. A fresh image-based IJ container can map host16432 to internal15432. Guard connection transport port16432 separately from server current_setting(port)=15432. Image scope rust-r0e and new container/volume scope rust-r2ij are distinct checks.
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.ownerRoleCaveat: Frozen entrypoint initializes poms_r0e_owner. Retain that owner name only within the new cluster unless Root explicitly freezes a new entrypoint; a proposed poms_r2ij_owner is not available automatically.

proposedIsolatedEnvironment.marker: Fresh UUID generated and frozen by Root, one r2ij_control.marker row per exact allowed database; no marker exists from this task
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.requiredDBIdentity: PG150012, isolated GUC on, internal port15432, exact owner/current/session user, database allowlist, UTF8/libc/en_US.UTF-8, stored+actual collation2.34, TimeZone Etc/GMT-8, pgcrypto1.3/btree_gist1.7; verify after creation. App role no superuser/createdb/createrole/bypassrls/replication/role memberships/schema CREATE/marker access.
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.migrationAndSeed: Run only frozen 92 historical migrations via original authority then original DatabaseSeeder on these fresh controlled copies, with one durable initialization intent. Retain schema/seed source hashes and classified schema diff; no generated DDL, reseeding existing DBs, TEST access or PG17 changes. Initial seeded rows are a preserved baseline, not owned per-run cleanup targets.
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.runtimeNetworkPlan: Run later build/API/fixture/OBS/browser helper processes in existing frozen images with explicitly scoped network=host to reach loopback16432 and API/OBS ports. Do not silently combine DB-container network namespace port15432 with host managed env DB_PORT16432; choose and freeze one context per helper.
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.localStorage: Separate host state objects/<backend>/<ownerTag>, bind only each backend subtree as writable /r2ij-objects/<backend>/<ownerTag>; set POMS_ATTACHMENT_LOCAL_ROOT before API startup. Owner tag fixes a server root; each run uses exact journaled keys. Never rely on cwd storage/attachments or share Nest/Rust roots. Reconcile all interrupted runs before deleting any directory; no recursive cleanup.
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.OBSStorage: New controlled upstream object state under IJ state only; exact backend+run bucket/key registries and synthetic AK/SK. No live vendor endpoints/credentials or deployment env. Support signed bucket HEAD, object PUT/HEAD/stream GET/DELETE, presigned PUT validation/expiry/metadata and deliberate network/status/stream failures. Stub accepting every signature is insufficient.
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.virtualHostCases: Default controlled cases can use forcePathStyle=true. freezePathStyle=false needs scoped container DNS/--add-host names mapping controlled bucket-host endpoints to loopback; do not edit host DNS/hosts or depend on external resolution. Preserve original URL/path/query/SigV4 behavior in comparison.
proposedIsolatedEnvironment.lifecycle: Before start assert both host port tables and exact metadata; record process PID/start identity, source/binary hashes, owner/backend/tag, bound origin and receipt path. Stop only owned matching processes; preserve volume and evidence; verify ports released. Any stale owner/journal mismatch blocks, never kill-by-port/prune/reset/drop.

Scoped settings/clock fault tests need a new exact column ledger or an isolated disposable backend DB with separately frozen restoration; no global restore-all SQL.
restoreAndCleanupScope.unknownReferences: All 107 frozen original poms tables and complete incoming shapes into new IJ/base/projection/support targets; include attachment_download_package, attachment_download_package_item, project_handover_attachment_selection and snapshot target_id JSON/text even though K is out of scope. Any unregistered referencing row blocks cleanup; do not adopt/delete it.
restoreAndCleanupScope.locationReferences: UUID closure alone cannot detect provider configurations because attachment/upload locations store provider+bucket+key, no configId. Before provider/object deletion inspect exact storage locations and prefix resolution across attachment/upload_session/download_package, including unowned rows. Unknown object/consumer or changed hash blocks, never delete by provider prefix alone.
restoreAndCleanupScope.objectOwnership: Durable pre-write exact backend/run/location/expected byte count/SHA256/row linkage ledger. Capture changed/missing/orphan state after failed/expired/abort/stream cases. Preflight DB+all owned objects before first destructive action. Local canonical containment+no symlinks, OBS exact synthetic bucket/key, no recursive/root/bucket/prefix cleanup. testConnection temp writes need exact observed registered key under dedicated owner root; no blanket .poms-storage-test prefix deletion.
restoreAndCleanupScope.order: After owned requests/processes settle, restore only registered fault columns and verify hashes/fingerprints; acquire complete reference guards and object preflight. Delete exact owned upload sessions and attachment links before attachment rows; preserve/handle version chain dependencies. Delete owned handover before its snapshots/term snapshot, follow-up before customer/lead/project, term before contract, contract before project, project before lead, lead before customer, then exact owned audit/security/base rows. Re-evaluate actual frozen FK/identity graph; this prose is not executable deletion SQL.
restoreAndCleanupScope.distributedFailure: DB and filesystem/OBS cleanup is not one atomic transaction. Journal each phase durably; do not mark cleaned until both stores verify zero. Abort on new reference or changed object, preserve residuals for exact recovery and do not rewrite historical round outcomes.
restoreAndCleanupScope.repeatZero: Two fresh per-backend exact DB/object residue scans after lawful cleanup, preserved results and final runtime/port/source/binary identity checks; no statement of actual zero is made by this inventory.
